additional_info.subject: RE: [External] ID0383871-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / P4 170000481] Screensaver update CRM:00921001189
additional_info.body:
Hello Iris van Dam,
Thanks for the response.
We apologize for the delayed response. After checking with the expert team, we confirmed that the image sizes were reduced to 0 KB and 1 KB, which is why they are not visible. This issue has been resolved in the latest firmware version, v5.0.21, and updating to this version should resolve the issue.
Could you please confirm if the charger can be updated to the latest firmware version? If so, kindly provide the date and time so we can proceed with the upgrade.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
